description.value: HI Vancouver Downtown is a Hostelling International hostel located in Vancouver's West End, a flat, bike-friendly neighbourhood close to Stanley Park and the downtown core. As part of the HI Canada network, it caters to budget-conscious travellers and is well-positioned along popular urban cycling routes. The hostel occupies a dedicated building on a quiet residential street just blocks from the seawall.
